intent.raw: Refresh the interactive ontology learning-map Invoke package from the accepted DomainSpec v2 engine-gap findings.
intent.objective: Produce a proposal-only, evidence-linked correction that makes the learning map consume owner-generated DomainSpec Sg without changing target or upstream authority.
intent.operator_sentence: Refresh the plan, but do not let the learning map become the DomainSpec graph authority.

boundaries.contract: Inventory provides non-authority handles and residue; Invoke verifies material claims against the owner-held findings.
The learning map may propose an exact read-only Sg receipt gate but may not create relations, FPR states, gap identities, or engine acceptance.
Refresh outputs are proposal-only; existing target artifacts remain unchanged until apply-approved authority exists.

authority.promotion: DomainSpec, CAV2, Definitions, and target owners remain separate

state_namespaces.write_policy: write only under the dated refresh folder
no writes or status changes from this dispatch

promotion_splits.target: DomainSpec graph, definitions, FPR state, and target implementation
promotion_splits.rule: Evidence may propose gates and deltas but requires each target owner before mutation or promotion.

steps.name: Resolve refresh source and target inventory
stop_conditions: block if either machine-index entry is missing
block if an Inventory row is treated as ontology or lifecycle authority

steps.name: Build strict selector-level refresh context
stop_conditions: block if a refresh obligation lacks selector-level evidence
block if the context pack widens into unbounded source transcripts

steps.name: Normalize signals and author proposal-only deltas
stop_conditions: block if a proposed delta lacks a RefreshSignal
block if any existing target or DomainSpec artifact changes
block if projection ownership is allowed to waive DomainSpec authority

steps.name: Validate refresh artifacts and route boundaries
stop_conditions: block on dispatch schema or technique errors
flag rather than hand off when target apply approval is absent

gates.condition: Source evidence, target inventory, scope, evidence date, and proposal-only mode are explicit.
Only the dated refresh folder changes; existing target and upstream artifacts remain unchanged.

gates.owner: DomainSpec, CAV2, Definitions, and target owners
gates.condition: The refresh proposes read-only Sg consumption and does not promote evidence, relations, graph state, definitions, or lifecycle state.
Target mutation remains deferred until G-OWNER and the external FPR receipt chain are satisfied and an apply-approved refresh validates.
Dispatch, JSON, links, target paths, and no-target-mutation checks return evidence.

promotion_guardrails: Inventory and research evidence are non-authority inputs.
Invoke owns only the refresh proposal, not target application or FPR lifecycle state.
The learning map consumes DomainSpec Sg read-only and cannot mint DomainSpec relations or replacement gap identities.
Proposal approval is not implementation, FPR closure, ontology promotion, or publication approval.
